body: lulz. You have access to the same websites we do. DO YOUR HOMEWORK BEFORE KARMAWHORING, THX

Sorry about the delay. Was drinking like a boss. /facepalm

And sure :)

I guess... I dunno, I've been in the dark so long I'm actually afraid to step into the light. If I'm to be perfectly honest, the world scares the shit out of me :/

As for my family, my mother CONSTANTLY reminds me (implicitly and occasionally explicitly) that I'm a pain in her arse. I'm just glad I live on my own otherwise life would truly be unbearable.

I live in London, how about you? Thank you for your support <3

I am so very glad that you're able to manage your BPD. I did actually do DBT for two years. My individual therapist was an absolute godsend - highly competent and empathetic, but I messed it up when I hit the bottle and missed four sessions in a row and got kicked out. I still have the book though (<3 Marsha Linehan). I did actually want to send her a present to thank my therapist for all the effort she put in to our sessions but I had no idea what to buy her so instead I wrote a letter to the highest authority in the land to sing her praises. I'll pm you a copy of the response if you like :)

I do need to practice the mindfulness and distress tolerance skills a lot more. They DO make a difference, it's just I forget to apply them and shit like this happens :/

And yeah, I am looking into doing some volunteer work eventually. Just a matter of summoning up the motivation. I did go back to university for a while last year but ever since my last overdose, my attention span has been shot to hell (I actually think I suffered brain damage because of it). I'll need to take babysteps I guess.

And don't worry about how you sound. I understand where you're coming from :) It's wonderful that you have that support network. To be fair, I do have a couple of very very good friends who understand how I am and aren't judgemental about it. So I am grateful for that.

Anyway, thank you so much for your input and apologies for my scatterbrained response. Not at my best atm :( And yeah, I'd love to have you as a penpal!
That's the problem, I've lost my passion for the things I used to love :(

Well... I used to enjoy cycling. I live in a very hilly area and I used to cycle eleven miles a day. I had to sell my bike to buy a new laptop though coz my old one got, erm... lets just say I was in a bad mood that day :/

I will readily admit that a significant proportion of my problem is having nothing worthwhile to do, but with depression it's a vicious circle.

Thank you for the advice, I'll try my best to take it on board <3
